cases.note: The position (tiers.PositionPromptInput: a value bound into a prompt's input) has no MemQL expression to seed today: no shipped construct binds a prompt input from DSL, and ai(...) written in a logic body loads but fails when it runs ("ai() cannot be evaluated in this context; use it only in projection expressions"), so it cannot be a case an author copies. The template's load gate -- every variable a prompt's template reads is declared (E6 of the record, kept by D7) -- is where a prompt's input meets its values today, and stands in for the position. dsl-v1-expressions replaces these seeds when the position gets its per-node-kind entries.
The input schema refuses a key it does not declare before the template renders, so a hole the prompt does not declare could never be filled.
